tob-4282: Apollodorus’s Book-hoard — in Frazer’s Englishing — is the great handbook of Greek god-tales, summing gods and heroes from the wells. The 100s compiler saved tales else lost. Frazer’s notes fatten the text. The work is the classic one-book Greek wonder-tales.
bat-wing-pg6382: Sax Rohmer, famed for the villainous Dr. Fu Manchu, turns to classic detective mystery in this thriller. arxiv-2605-08982: Giving a model more thinking time at inference improves answers, but the search must be principled and parallel. arxiv-2605-09582: Singular product spaces — products marred by bad points — need both topology and category theory to be understood. Yusuke Hayashi and Tristan van der Vlugt bring both toolkits to bear on them. The 2026 paper is pure mathematics on beautifully rough spaces.
arxiv-2605-09682: When a Lambda-b baryon decays to Lambda plus D, spin and flavor entangle — and the pattern reveals weak phases. Yong Du, Chao-Qiang Geng, Xiao-Gang He, and colleagues extract them. The 2026 paper is flavor physics at its most delicate.

plos-pone-0352682: Children in the emergency department often get blood drawn twice — once at their clinic, once again at the hospital. This study modeled when repeat testing is truly necessary in pediatric EDs. Predicting necessity could spare kids painful re-draws and cut waste.
plos-pone-0349282: Killing staph on living skin without harming the patient is the trick. plos-pone-0351782: As the climate shifts, freshwater species need connected refuges to survive. plos-pone-0343482: Dementia care planning should be personal — but primary care appointments are rushed. plos-pone-0357782: Odd sounds yank our attention away — but does repeating a response change how distracting they are? plos-pone-0356182: 3D-printing titanium parts demands precisely tuned laser power. plos-pone-0357382: Three-dimensional animation files are enormous — and streaming them demands smarter compression. plos-pone-0357482: Blanket fertilizer application wastes money and pollutes waterways. Smart fertigation automates fertilizer delivery based on actual plant growth, using digital sensors with IoT capability. The system feeds each plant precisely what it needs, when it needs it — no more, no less.

plos-pone-0350782: Gonorrhea is outrunning antibiotics — and entirely new weapons are needed. plos-pone-0353482: COPD doesn’t just damage the lungs — it disrupts the autonomic nervous system that governs the heart. plos-pone-0353382: Europe’s pollinators need a common language for data to be shared. The EU pollinator hub controlled vocabulary is exactly that — an ontology for pollinators. plos-pone-0356782: Liver cirrhosis patients need sustained follow-up — and nurses may be the answer. plos-pone-0356482: Virtual screening for drug candidates produces ranked lists — but decisions need calibrated confidence. plos-pone-0356382: Radiomic features from diffusion-weighted MRI could diagnose pediatric brain tumors — but only if they’re stable. plos-pone-0355682: Black cumin — Nigella sativa — is a valuable Ethiopian crop, but its yield stability was unmapped. plos-pone-0354482: Nesprin1 — a nuclear envelope protein — may play an unexpected role in heart failure. plos-pone-0347282: Artificial sweeteners’ effects on bones and joints were poorly understood. plos-pone-0355482: Counting carbon in plantation forests requires equations tuned to each species and site. plos-pone-0350882: Myofascial neck pain — the modern desk worker’s curse — might yield to ultrasound-guided fascia hydrorelease. plos-pone-0354982: Ehretia cymosa — an Ethiopian medicinal plant — was put to the antibacterial test. plos-pone-0354882: Centella asiatica — gotu kola — is touted for brain health, but which molecules matter? plos-pone-0354682: Malaysian chronic disease patients who believe in complementary medicine — do they skip their pills? plos-pone-0354082: Meals on Wheels clients — hearing health checks embedded in the existing service. The SOUND-BITES pilot protocol outlines it.
